newsitem.title: USA: South Carolina Senate approves local tax bill.
newsitem.headline: South Carolina Senate approves local tax bill.

text.p: South Carolina's Senate has approved a bill allowing counties to seek voter approval for local-option sales taxes.
The proposal passed in a voice vote Thursday.
A slightly different version had already passed in the House, so the bill now heads to a conference committee.
The proposal creates a local-option sales tax for infrastructure projects. Voter approval would be required and the tax would expire after seven years.
The bill also authorizes local-option taxes of up to 3 percent on hotel rooms and up to 2 percent on meals at restaurants that serve alcohol. That tax also would require voter approval.
